collections.name: The Human Condition
collections.description: The fragile, beautiful business of being human. Portraits, gold-mended forms and dreamlike scenes explore love, loss, belonging and the courage to begin again.

collections.name: Words That Matter
collections.description: Images with something to say. Expressive faces, strong contrasts and visual metaphors give feeling a form — sometimes through painted words, sometimes without a single word.

collections.name: Symbolic Street Art
collections.description: Where emotion meets the city wall. Symbolic figures, gold-lit fractures, graffiti and pop-art colour carry stories of grief, defiance, tenderness and the hope that survives.

collections.name: Mediterranean Soul
collections.description: Light to return to. Imagined coastlines, terraces and quiet horizons hold the warmth of the Mediterranean and the feeling of a moment you wish would last.

collections.name: Earth & Emotion
collections.description: A quieter kind of intensity. Earth colours, botanical forms and tactile-looking digital textures create space for reflection, renewal and a little stillness.

collections.name: City After Dark
collections.description: Rain, neon, late-night windows and the private lives of cities after daylight disappears.

collections.name: Sunken Worlds
collections.description: Lost architecture beneath the surface — temples, libraries, statues and imagined civilizations reclaimed by the sea.

collections.name: Studio Archive
collections.description: A wider view of the studio: experiments in period-inspired composition, abstraction and portraiture. Different styles, connected by an interest in atmosphere and human stories.
